newsitem.title: USA: Bon-Ton results benefit Crown American.
newsitem.headline: Bon-Ton results benefit Crown American.

text.p: Crown American Realty Trust said Tuesday the improved sales and income of Bon-Ton Stores Inc are expected to have a "modest, positive effect" on its funds from operations (FFO) earnings.
Crown American said that in 1996, sales increased dramatically at the 14 Bon-Ton deparrment stores in its rental portfolio.
As a result, it expects an approximate additional $0.01 a share in FFO earnings due to additonal revenue from the corresponding higher rent paid by the Bon-Ton stores, it said.

"Just as the turnaround at Sears (Roebuck and Co ) had a positive effect on Crown American, so has the recent sales and profitability of Bon-Ton," said Mark Pasquerilla, president of the regional shopping mall owner and operator.
Pasquerilla said that in addition to higher rent, the shopping malls the company operates experienced additional traffic and sales.
